en: A black and white photograph depicting a formal landscaped garden area with elaborate flowerbeds, low decorative fencing, and people dressed in late 19th-century or early 20th-century formal attire. Behind the garden stands an ornate pavilion-like building with an elaborate roofline, dome, and arched windows, with other tall, historic European buildings in the background. A sign reading 'AMLER' is visible on one building.
